clickType: Tap a season to see more!

springbright.name: Bright Spring
descriptions: Bright Spring carries the bright, warm energy of spring — with the crisp contrast of winter woven in.
Your spectrum is wide: from light to dark, cool to warm, you can pull off almost anything.
High-contrast pairings like black and white flatter you the most.
You wear bright, high-saturation colors beautifully — the more vivid, the better.
Avoid muted, grayed-out colors — they'll make your face look dull.

springwarm.name: True Spring
descriptions: The warmest of the springs, True Spring is one of the rarest types among Koreans.
Warm, yellow-based hues suit you best — and no one wears orange quite like you do.
With your lively, lovely energy, deep and saturated colors flatter you even more than the typical soft spring pastels.
Build on a beige or brown base and add pops of vibrant color. Shiny gold accessories are your best friend.
Cool tones, grayed-out shades, and low-contrast styling all dull your natural glow — steer clear.

springlight.name: Light Spring
descriptions: Full of freshness and vitality, Light Spring is the type that wears young spring colors best.
Among spring colors, light and delicate warm tones — those tinted with white — suit you most.
Like True Spring, your palette is colorful — but softer, with gentler saturation.
Ivory, coral, yellow, and light green look beautiful on you, and soft cool tones work too.
Steer clear of overly pale cool tones and dark, heavy shades like true black.

summerlight.name: Light Summer
descriptions: Light Summer is the clearest, brightest of the summer seasons.
You're a classic cool tone with a hint of Light Spring's warmth peeking through.
Soft sky blue, lavender, and light pink suit you — and bright, vivid colors or beige work nicely too.
A crisp white tee with jeans looks effortlessly fresh on you.
Dark autumn tones don't flatter you, and edgy streetwear isn't quite your vibe.

summercool.name: True Summer
descriptions: The coolest of the summers, True Summer is one of the most common types in Korea.
Cool, bright blues suit you best, and you can wear any classic cool tone with ease.
You pull off light pastels with quiet elegance.
Statement pieces and accessories that create contrast look great on you.
Steer clear of yellows and warm-toned colors.

summermute.name: Soft Summer
descriptions: Soft Summer evokes a hazy, cool summer just before autumn arrives.
Among summer colors, the muted, low-saturation shades flatter you most.
If a color has that soft, hazy quality, you can even pull off muted autumn warm tones.
Sharp, intense colors, vivid neons, and extremes of light or dark don't suit you.
Reach for ivory instead of white, and dark brown or gray instead of black — and go easy on high contrast.

autumnmute.name: Soft Autumn
descriptions: Evoking a lazy autumn afternoon, Soft Autumn is one of the most common types in Korea.
Soft, milky, low-saturation colors flatter you beautifully.
Instead of high-contrast black and white, gentle browns like beige, oatmeal, and dark brown suit you far more.
You carry an antique, vintage-yet-refined vibe — denim and lace look wonderful on you.
Sharp, vivid colors, neons, or strong yellows will overpower your face and feel unnatural.

autumnwarm.name: True Autumn
descriptions: Evoking crimson and gold autumn leaves, True Autumn is the warmest of the autumn seasons.
Warm tones suit you well — and you wear forsythia yellow and orange-red with real elegance.
Instead of cool black or white, warm colors like ivory, beige, and brown will serve you better.
Bold patterns flatter you more than fine prints, and floral prints look great on you. Contoured makeup suits you too.
Cool tones and grayish shades will dim your warmth — best to avoid them.

autumndeep.name: Dark Autumn
descriptions: Dark Autumn is the deepest of the autumn seasons — autumn on the cusp of winter.
Deep, weighty warm tones — brown, burgundy, khaki, navy — flatter you. Dark cool tones work too.
Black suits you, but a softened black works better than a sharp, jet black.
Bold patterns and statement accessories enhance your appeal. Contoured or smoky makeup looks great on you.
Steer clear of vivid neons and pale, white-tinted colors.

winterdeep.name: Dark Winter
descriptions: Radiating a mysterious aura, Dark Winter is all about deep, dark colors.
Deep, cool tones suit you best — and you can borrow the darkest shades from the autumn palettes too.
No one wears purple like you do, and simple black-and-white outfits look striking on you.
Contrast is your secret weapon — accents of vivid or bright color really work for you.
Avoid fine prints and hazy, watercolor-style patterns with low contrast.

wintercool.name: True Winter
descriptions: Evoking freshly fallen snow, True Winter is the coolest of the winter seasons — every cool tone suits you.
Magenta and deep purple are your signatures, and jewel tones like emerald green, ruby red, and sapphire blue look stunning on you.
The classic black-and-white pairing is your best look, and adding sharp, bold accents makes your presence shine even more.
Go for clean, crisp fabrics — silk and other lustrous winter materials look especially beautiful on you.
Lemon yellow works for you, but warmer, golden yellows are harder to pull off.

winterbright.name: Bright Winter
descriptions: With a spoonful of spring sunlight added to winter, Bright Winter shines in clean, clear colors.
You can wear even vivid neons with elegance, and neutrals like white, black, and gray look sharp on you.
High contrast is essential — pair extremes of light and dark, or combine bold, saturated colors.
Glossy fabrics look great on you — think polished leather and sparkling statement accessories.
Tiny prints, muted colors, and low-contrast outfits will dim your natural spark — best avoided.
